nodes.intent: Initial solution

Add vectorized window features for key SMART counters and normalized attributes, train 3-fold LightGBM with sample weights, average fold models for query scoring, and select a robust OOF threshold with a conservative query-distribution fallback.

Build compact temporal features from the 14-day window, train a weighted LightGBM plus logistic out-of-fold ensemble, and select a robust weighted-F1 alarm threshold with fold stability and quantile matching.

Extend feature builder with d1/d3/d7/d14, positive/log deltas, became/reset/missing flags.
Train 3-fold LightGBM OOF plus final model and blend fold/final scores.
Choose threshold from OOF weighted-F1 plateau and alarm top-k fraction on query.

Compute target encodings inside each CV fold using training-fold labels only.
Rank-normalize selected SMART last-day attributes within model/vendor using train+query features without labels.
Keep robust OOF plateau threshold selection with fold-percentile tie-breaking.

扩展 SMART 窗口趋势、厂商/型号 rank/z 特征。
LightGBM 使用 3-fold OOF 概率平均预测 query。
用 OOF 加权 F1 曲线选择阈值，并加入零/全报警兜底策略。

Expand the parent GBDT feature set with temporal window/slope and critical-count features; add model/vendor frequency features; keep OOF threshold selection but optimize weighted F1_p10 and add a conservative query alarm-rate guard.

Add multi-scale window statistics, critical SMART count features, more interactions, vendor/model-aware features, tuned LightGBM parameters, and weighted OOF threshold selection maximizing bootstrap p10 F1.

Build vectorized 14-day SMART window features; train LightGBM with 3-fold OOF and logistic fallback; choose threshold on OOF weighted F1 with precision tie-breaking; quantile-match query scores for alarms.

Add richer trend/change and rank features, average fold-model predictions, optionally calibrate OOF-to-query scores, and select a robust weighted-F1 threshold with conservative plateau selection and time-budgeted tree counts.

Expand vectorized features with recent/old means, median, pos/low flags, vendor and capacity.
Train 3-fold weighted LightGBM with early stopping and average fold models for query scores.
Select alarm threshold from OOF predictions using robust weighted F1 lower bound.
保留父方案特征工程与 LightGBM；扩充窗口统计/半窗趋势/关键 SMART 非零计数；用 3 折 OOF 选择稳健报警比例；查询分数由 fold 模型平均得到。

Add expanded trend/rate/window features, 3-fold OOF fold-average ensemble, rank-blended score, OOF threshold selection, and imbalance-aware weighting while keeping vectorized groupby aggregation and bounded LightGBM trees.
保留父方案的高效特征构建与 LightGBM 主体；扩充关键 SMART 统计与半窗趋势特征；加入 LR 秩融合、折平均预测和更稳健的 OOF 阈值选择；保持运行时间可控。

Graft the sibling improvements into the parent LightGBM pipeline: expanded window features, fold-model average predictions, optional LR rank ensemble gated by OOF AUPRC, calibrated positive-weight training, and robust OOF threshold/alarm-rate policy.

Extend the LightGBM feature builder with median/std-like aggregates, recent/old trends, deltas, missing/history-length signals, and vendor/capacity features.
Use group-aware OOF folds, average fold-model query scores, select a robust plateau threshold, and adapt alarms only when counts are degenerate.

Expand cutoff-day and half-window SMART trend features; average fold-model scores; select robust weighted alarm thresholds from OOF predictions; use regularized LightGBM and silent-positive down-weighting.
Use temporal, trend, median/std, reset, nonzero-count, vendor, capacity features; train 3-fold LightGBM ensemble; select robust OOF threshold.
Expand feature engineering modestly, use 3-fold fold-model averaging, robust bootstrap threshold selection, and defensive alarm-rate alignment under strict runtime/static constraints.
Expand feature engineering, average multiple LightGBM fold models, select OOF thresholds by bootstrap p10 weighted F1, and keep adaptive model/fold budgets for runtime safety.
保留向量化特征构建与 LightGBM 核心，扩展特征与模型配置；使用 OOF 阈值、fold-model 平均预测、可选 isotonic 校准；用加权 bootstrap p10 F1 选择稳健报警阈值，并控制树数与运行时间。

Update feature engineering to add all raw cutoff/window statistics, critical median/max/min, half-window trends, nonzero counters, and log1p deltas for workload SMARTs; keep LightGBM core with scale_pos_weight and fold-model averaging; replace threshold selection with OOF bootstrap-percentile weighted F1 and robust alarm-rate fallback.
Keep vectorized feature builder, add vendor-aware trends, OOF threshold, fold-model averaging, capped trees, and alarm rate safeguards.

Keep the LightGBM core and vectorized feature builder; add median/std, position/reset, half-window, missing, vendor/model codes; average fold-model scores; choose robust threshold via bootstrap percentile F1 and map query scores to OOF distribution for alarms.
Add vectorized trend/change features, 3-fold LightGBM ensemble, weighted bootstrap threshold selection, and dynamic tree budget for runtime control.

Use cutoff-day and half-window SMART statistics, vendor/capacity features, 3-fold LightGBM averaged query scores, weighted bootstrap F1 threshold, and conservative per-vendor thresholds only when enough positives exist.
adopted_cards: T05: per-vendor thresholds only with enough positives and shrink toward base threshold. M05: hand-crafted 14-day window features with GBDT instead of deep sequence models.

nodes.intent: Initial solution

Introduce delta/d3/d7 and became-nonzero features over the cutoff window.
Train LightGBM with out-of-fold threshold calibration and heuristic-rank score blending.
Keep runtime low by subsampling negatives and limiting features/trees.

Train 3-fold LightGBM with weighted sample weights, average fold models for query scores, calibrate scores monotonically when safe, and choose an alarm threshold from OOF weighted F1 with a false-alarm-rate guard and bootstrap-robust plateau selection.
Add temporal delta/diff/max features, vendor/model prior features, 3-fold OOF LightGBM scoring, probability calibration, and bootstrap-p10 alarm threshold selection with score-scale safety.

Adopted knowledge cards M01, T01, E01, E05: LightGBM on engineered window features, out-of-fold threshold selection, weighted bootstrap F1_p10 approximation, and runtime-aware feature/CV choices. Build last/first/mean/max/min plus delta, slope, recent, range features for selected SMART attributes, add vendor one-hot and capacity, train 3-fold LightGBM with sample weights, average fold models for query scores, and select/quantile-adjust the threshold under a time budget.

Replace the parent cutoff-day model with a LightGBM workflow. Add vendor/model-aware rank features, missing-value handling, and OOF threshold selection. Apply a calibrated alarm policy to improve robust F1 without distorting score ranking.
保留原特征构建与3折CV；增加recent3/7、jump、norm count、bad-sector交互；调整LightGBM参数；用OOF bootstrap p10选择阈值；平均折模型预测查询集。
保留父方案向量化特征构建与 LightGBM；新增 median/std、pos flags、recent/old 半窗趋势和关键属性；使用 OOF 阈值、fold-model 平均预测、可选 isotonic 校准，并控制树数与运行时间。

Replace cutoff-only logistic with engineered temporal LightGBM features.
Choose thresholds on OOF scores, not in-sample scores.
Add fallback scoring and alarm-rate safety caps.
保留父方案的加权阈值与稳健选择逻辑；替换为 LightGBM 三折集成预测；增加趋势/误差增长/型号排名特征与厂商感知；按磁盘级 OOF 选择 F1_p10 阈值。

Use LightGBM with expanded SMART trend features while keeping NaNs for unreported attributes.
Add group-aware OOF training and weighted threshold selection with bootstrap F1_p10.
Tune positive class weighting against fleet weights and fallback to logistic if LightGBM is unavailable.

Train fold-wise LightGBM + LR on the new recent-day lag/trend features; blend ranks (tuned by OOF weighted AUPRC) for `score`; select the alarm threshold from OOF calibrated probabilities via weighted F1_p10; fold-average query predictions for stability.

Replace the cutoff-day logistic baseline with an LGB/logistic ensemble on disk-level trend features; select threshold from weighted OOF with bootstrap p10; keep score ranking for AUPRC/R@FAR and use aligned scores only for alarm decisions.
Keep the LightGBM core, expand feature engineering and model configuration, and select a robust weighted threshold using bootstrap percentile F1.

Replace cutoff-only logistic style with a lightweight LightGBM pipeline, expand temporal/vendor features conservatively, select alarms by bootstrap F1_p10 approximation, and enforce runtime/memory safety via negative downsampling and vectorized groupby features.

Graft expanded temporal features, vendor/model codes, missing-day telemetry, sample-weighted OOF threshold, delta-rule guardrails, silent positive downweighting, and rank-preserving score distribution matching.
Keep the LightGBM pipeline but expand temporal features, winsorize raw counters, use bagged rank-averaged LightGBM, and choose a robust OOF threshold with alarm-rate safety caps.

- Add P06-style raw-counter winsorisation/reset features and richer 14-day trend/availability features.
- Use a regularized LightGBM setup (max_depth 6, min_child_samples 30, strong leaf regularization) and robust weighted bootstrap F1 threshold selection with a false-alarm cap.

Use 3-fold out-of-fold LightGBM probabilities for threshold selection, with logistic-regression fallback; expand SMART trend features with reset/clipped deltas, normalized badness, temperature, and jump indicators; keep weighted bootstrap F1_p10 thresholding.
扩展历史趋势/交互/厂商型号特征；使用 3 折 OOF 选择加权 F1 阈值；训练 bagged LightGBM 并对查询分数做 rank 校准后再报警，保持 AUPRC 排序能力。

1. 构建截止值、first/last/min/max、delta/range/reset/dperday等历史趋势特征。
2. 使用3折LightGBM OOF概率、Platt校准与bootstrap加权F1阈值选择。
3. 保留负增量截断、重置标记和正则化参数，避免过拟合。
Add richer temporal and vendor-aware features, use LightGBM with conservative tree parameters, perform OOF threshold selection, and map the chosen alarm fraction to the final query scores.

1. 使用 LightGBM 建模并保留 logistic 回退；增加 trend、reset、recent/older mean、vendor_capacity 等特征。
2. 采纳 L03 正则化与静默正例降权，采纳 P06 计数 reset 与负向变化裁剪。
3. OOF 阈值选择 + 报警率校准，保持低误报下的稳健 F1。
Graft LightGBM and expanded trend/vendor features into the parent pipeline, keep weighted OOF threshold selection, and replace absolute thresholding with a fraction-matched alarm policy.

Add std-based volatility features, critical-counter reset/clip features, and more normalized SMART attributes.
Use 3-fold out-of-fold LightGBM with tuned regularized parameters and averaged fold predictions.
Choose a robust weighted threshold from OOF scores and map it to the query score quantile.

Add LightGBM OOF scoring and richer SMART trend/diff features; calibrate alarms from OOF with shrunk per-vendor thresholds only when enough positives exist; fallback to robust top-rate alarms when query score distribution shifts.

补全并增强历史趋势特征：厂商 one-hot、容量、日变化、窗口均值/极值/标准差、加速度与相对变化。
使用 3 折 OOF 训练 LightGBM，查询分数取折模型平均；阈值用加权 F1 曲线与 bootstrap F1_p10 选择，并做分位数兜底。
避免逐盘循环、早停/verbose 等易触发 smoke 失败的写法。

- Build 14-day history features: last/first/max/min/mean plus delta, slope, range, last-minus-mean for key SMART counters.
- Train 3-fold LightGBM with weighted positive emphasis and silent-positive down-weighting; fall back to logistic if needed.
- Choose a robust OOF threshold for alarms and adjust only if query score distribution is severely mismatched.

1. 保留 14 天窗口、趋势/变化、厂商特征和 LightGBM 路线。
2. 使用 3 折 OOF 概率选择加权 F1 阈值，并将最终 score rank 化。
3. 按 OOF 报警比例设置查询集 alarm，避免最终模型概率分布漂移导致阈值失配。

Expand temporal features and model/vendor features; train 3-fold LightGBM with sample weights; select alarm threshold via weighted bootstrap lower-F1; blend model probabilities with heuristic rank; output score/alarm per index row.

Expand SMART window features with std/count/cv/jump/reset/min-reset signals and vendor/model handling. Tune LightGBM for low prevalence and regularize it. Select the alarm threshold from OOF predictions using a weighted bootstrap lower-percentile objective, with fallback SMART scores if the learned pipeline is degenerate.

Build a self-contained program that reads only the four allowed files, computes 14-day window trend/vendor features via vectorized groupby.agg, trains a 3-fold OOF LightGBM (logistic fallback), selects a weighted-F1 alarm threshold with a FAR cap, applies a data-driven SMART-delta rule boost, and writes serial_number,score,alarm.

1) 增加 last3/mid7/old 分段均值、accel/trend、坏扇区/温度/容量/厂商交互派生特征。
2) 调整 LightGBM 参数为更深但更正则化的 300 棵树配置。
3) 用 OOF 分折 F1 的 20 百分位选择稳健阈值，并将阈值映射到查询集分数分位以稳定报警率。

1. 增加 last/mean/max/min/std、first、mean3/mean7、delta/range/spike/gt0 等历史趋势特征。
2. 使用加权 LightGBM 的 3 折 OOF 预测选择阈值，并按折间 F1 稳定性与 FAR 惩罚校准报警。
3. 对 top SMART 增量添加保守 score 规则护栏，并对报警数量做最小/上限保护。

Add min/slope/missing SMART features, expand vendor prefixes, tune LightGBM, use 3-fold OOF plus final ensemble scores, and select a robust alarm threshold by OOF weighted F1 bootstrap p10 with a FAR cap.
Initial solution

- Extend SMART window features with recent deltas, normalized SMART, and model target encoding/categorical.
- Select alarm threshold using weighted lower-bound F1 and map to final score quantile.
- Keep LightGBM ensemble lightweight and vectorized to stay fast and robust to missing data.

Use 3-fold out-of-fold LightGBM predictions to select a weighted-F1 threshold with fold stability and a minimum alarm-count guard.
Ensemble the fold models for query scores, and apply a conservative alarm-rate guard if the query score distribution shifts.
Add recent-window mean/min/max and distribution features for key SMART attributes.

Train LightGBM with optional logistic ensemble on 14-day SMART trend features; select ensemble weight on weighted OOF ranking; choose alarm threshold from OOF bootstrap F1_p10 with query-distribution safety adjustment.

- Select alarm threshold from OOF scores using weighted conservative F1.
- Add LightGBM monotone constraints and raw severity/missing flags.
- Keep 3-fold OOF + full model, no model-specific categorical priors.
Replace cutoff-only logistic regression with LightGBM; add first/last deltas, log levels, composite error-growth features, vendor/model codes; select threshold on 3-fold OOF weighted F1.
Keep the feature builder vectorized and lightweight, add sparse trend/rank features, and choose a robust weighted-F1 threshold using OOF scores.
最小修改：保留原读取与建模骨架；扩展少量 SMART 属性；加入 diff_last、diff3、std-free 聚合；用 OOF 折均分预测 query；用近似 bootstrap 下界选择阈值；输出有限 score 与 0/1 alarm。

Build window aggregates, deltas, slopes, missing counts and one-day changes; use 3-fold LightGBM with sample weights; choose threshold via weighted OOF F1 and bootstrap p10; keep runtime bounded with sparse features and early stopping.

Expand key SMART features with 190/192/193 and recent-change flags, keep NaNs for LightGBM, train 3-fold CV ensemble, select threshold from weighted bootstrap p10, then control query alarm count near the OOF rate.

Expand SMART features with last-3/7 means, last-two-day deltas, and robust log transforms; train 3-fold LightGBM ensembles with weights; choose threshold by weighted F1_p10 proxy; map query scores to OOF quantiles and suppress alarms for disks without history.

Extend the 14-day SMART feature set with normalized drops and pending/reallocated patterns, keep vectorized groupby aggregation, and select a weighted out-of-fold alarm threshold under a false-alarm-rate cap.

Keep the LightGBM pipeline but add sparse SMART trend/age/missing indicators.
Use 5-fold OOF scores and select the alarm threshold by maximizing bootstrap F1_p10 with a FAR penalty.

1. 在现有特征上加入 age_days_log 与 hfh_ratio，不引入 rank/burst 等已证伪特征。
2. 使用 3 折 LightGBM OOF + 全量模型平均作为 score；报警按 OOF 加权 F1 平台对应分数位取 top-K。
3. 加入 Logistic 和启发式回退，保持向量化构建与低模型复杂度。
Add vectorized window trend features and small LightGBM; down-weight silent positives; choose threshold on OOF scores and match the resulting alarm fraction on query scores.
